notes: Initial actual-render verdict: REVISE_REQUIRED. Highest-value visible defect: the acquired new foot teleported during dual-support reacquisition and the final silhouette approached a translated idle reset.
Same-body correction: kept the new foot pinned at x=21 through reacquisition, landed the old foot separately at x=36, and lowered/canted the final root and tool so directional/support debt survives.

Fresh final-render PASS: high asymmetric brace compresses into a distinct tool-floor catch; the rear-foot+tool triangle visibly owns the hang; far-foot probe precedes ownership; tool unload waits for new-foot support; dual support arrives before height/tool recovery; overshoot and secondary shaft lag remain readable; no rear-anchor pivot/cross-body-exit grammar from Defense013 is reused.
TASTE: the diagonal brace collapsing into a literal tool-as-kickstand silhouette is specific rather than generic guard posing.

FUNCTION: impact, external floor support, triangular weight transfer, far-foot acquisition, tool unload, counter-travel, dual-support restack, late tool overshoot, and indebted ready state read as one causal chain.
CONTEMPT: the final performance does not read as mannequin symmetry, planted-feet theater, straight tweening, floating tool motion, reverse interpolation, or return-to-idle placeholder recovery.

keys.name: OFFSET_TOOL_READY
keys.causal_role: before-state: asymmetrical diagonal tool guard with unequal stance and slight task debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: tool claims high-right negative space while pelvis sits behind the diagonal

keys.name: SUNK_HIGH_BRACE
keys.causal_role: anticipation: root drops and shifts behind rear support before the upper-right threat arrives
keys.motion_arc_root_note: down-left brace; hands clamp the shaft while front knee softens

keys.name: TOOL_CRUSH_CONTACT
keys.causal_role: contact: tool folds toward torso and front support loses authority
keys.motion_arc_root_note: force drives tool/body down-left; contact is inside the brace, not farthest reach

keys.name: CRUSH_SHEAR_HOLD
keys.causal_role: consequence hold: torso and pelvis continue left/down while tool remains between threat and body
keys.motion_arc_root_note: rear foot owns root; front leg folds clear and tool torque continues after contact

keys.name: TOOL_HEAD_FLOOR_CATCH
keys.causal_role: external support acquisition: tool head strikes floor before the body can restack
keys.motion_arc_root_note: floor contact converts the diagonal implement into a temporary kickstand while rear foot still carries part of load

keys.name: KICKSTAND_HANG
keys.causal_role: support consequence: root travels under the tool/foot triangle instead of snapping upright
keys.motion_arc_root_note: tool head and rear foot stay world-locked while pelvis arcs left/up slightly and free leg tucks

keys.name: NEW_FOOT_PROBE
keys.causal_role: probe: free foot reaches far left while tool and old rear foot still own support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues left through the support triangle; probe precedes ownership

keys.name: TRIANGLE_TRANSFER
keys.causal_role: new-foot acquisition: far foot becomes trustworthy while old rear foot peels
keys.motion_arc_root_note: support triangle widens from new foot to tool head; root can now begin counter-travel

keys.name: TOOL_UNLOAD_PEEL
keys.causal_role: support handoff complete: tool head leaves floor only after new foot owns root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis rebounds right/up against pinned new foot; tool lags behind the root

keys.name: COUNTER_TRAVEL_TOOL_LAG
keys.causal_role: counter-travel: body comes back right while heavy tool is still climbing out of the catch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new foot remains fixed; pelvis passes right and shaft trails low

keys.name: TRAIL_FOOT_REACQUIRE
keys.causal_role: second support returns after the new foot has arrested the root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: trusted new foot remains x=21 while old foot reacquires at x=36; height recovery begins only after this dual support exists

keys.name: TOOL_REOPEN_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: tool authority reopens late and overshoots threatward after the feet are trustworthy
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new foot stays x=21 and old foot x=36 while hands/tool overshoot threatward on a later clock than pelvis/support

keys.name: SECONDARY_SHAFT_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: secondary lag: shaft, hands, head, and pelvis settle on staggered clocks
keys.motion_arc_root_note: both feet remain planted at the transferred base while shaft/head settle below the overshoot

keys.name: DISPLACED_KICKSTAND_READY
keys.causal_role: re-entry: defensive readiness returns at a new lateral address with residual tool-side debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new foot remains x=21 and final root x=27 stays lower and left of initial root x=43; tool also finishes lower, preserving visible defensive debt
